svg.aria-label: Flyer on charcoal with big, clean yellow-to-cyan gradient chess pieces floating: Self-play chess, my bachelor's thesis, an RL agent that learns chess from scratch with MCTS and CNNs, trained against Stockfish 16.1. On a dark board the pieces play an opening by themselves, 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6, while an evaluation bar swings.

g.text: my bachelor's thesis: an RL agent
Trained vs Stockfish it plays safe; vs weaker bots, it attacks.
